title: MCP-DETECT telemetry log record (v1)
description: One JSON-RPC 2.0 message observed by the stdio logging proxy, enriched with capture metadata, hashes, and labeling/provenance fields. See schema.md for prose documentation and the v0->v1 migration notes.

session_id.description: Generated once per proxy process invocation; constant across all lines in a session.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp (Z suffix) of when the proxy observed the line.

method.description: JSON-RPC method, if present. null for plain responses.

message_id.description: JSON-RPC id, if present. null for notifications.

tool_name.description: params.name when method == tools/call, else null.

tool_arguments.description: params.arguments when method == tools/call, else null.

result_summary.description: Truncated stringified preview of result/error for server_to_client responses, else null.

server_command.description: Sanitized identity of the wrapped server command. Common credential flag/assignment values are replaced before capture and hashing. Constant across all lines in a session.

tool_description_hash.description: Stable hash of {name, description, inputSchema} for tool_name, computed when tools/list revealed it. null when method != tools/call, or when tools/call happens before any tools/list response was observed this session.

server_version_hash.description: Stable hash of {server_name, server_version, server_command}, computed once initialize's response reveals serverInfo. null only for records preceding that response (i.e. at most the initialize request itself).

label.description: Ground-truth label for the session that produced this record. Set by the caller of the proxy (the corpus/attack harness), not inferred.

scenario_id.description: Coarse scenario identifier. Phase 1 benign corpus uses "benign"; later phases use named attack scenario identifiers.

task_id.description: Identifier for the specific task template this session ran (e.g. "read_and_summarize_file").

generator.description: Name/version stamp of the capture tool that produced this record, e.g. "mcp-detect-proxy/1.1".

raw.description: The complete, unmodified JSON-RPC 2.0 message as parsed from the wire.

proxy_anomaly.description: Present ONLY on a proxy-synthesized marker record noting a line on the stream could not be parsed as a JSON-RPC message -- absent (not null) on every real record, and never in `required` so existing v1 captures without this field stay valid unchanged. Metadata only: a reason code and the anomalous line's byte length, NEVER the line's actual content -- see schema.md.
